The '''hunter's hatchet''' is a {{MCD2|unique}} {{MCD2|melee weapon}}.

== Obtaining ==

* {{MCD2Link|Howling Woods}}
* {{MCD2Link|id=Deep Dark|The Deep Dark}}
* {{MCD2Link|Humbler Huskland}}

== Usage ==
The hunter's hatchet can be swung to deal minimum damage to nearby {{MCD2|mob}}s, but swinging continuously off cooldown causes it to combo, with the final attack dealing increased damage.

== Unique effect ==
The fixed effect of the hunter's hatchet is {{MCD2|Effect#Fletcher|Fletcher}}, which cannot be rerolled.
: ''Reduces ranged ammo cooldown time by 35%.''

== Compatible effects ==
The following {{MCD2|effect}}s can be obtained on the hunter's hatchet, either when found or when rerolled at the {{MCD2|blacksmith}}.{{MCD2 Effects|gear=melee|role=ranger|role2=summoner}}
